Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Doby & Disy: Exploring Journey (2025)
programme.desc: Adorable twin brother and sister, Doby & Disy, go on adventures in the magic forest together with their friends. They learn different colors, figures, songs and communication skills by solving various problems on the way.

programme.title: Hogie the Globehopper (2025)
programme.desc: Hogie the Globehopper is a fun tv show that will inspire a curiosity and fascination about the world and its people. Hogie and his friends Lorna, Bernie and Floaty travel the world, making lots of friends along the way.

programme.title: Princess Play Time (2025)
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Timmy Time (2025)
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Counting With Paula (2025)
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: Eva Braun
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 01
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.desc: Paul, Perry, and Dan head east of Timmins to the historic waters of Frederick House Lake for a late-season ice adventure under warm, spring-like skies. programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Armenia, un niño de 6 años fue hallado sin vida en el río Quindío. La investigación inicial sospechó de sus padres y de Jhony, mayordomo de una finca cercano a la madre, Liliana. Evidencias reconstructivas señalaron a Jhony como el principal sospechoso. En el juicio, confesó su participación y reveló que su jefe fue cómplice y autor directo del crimen. Jhony fue condenado a 40 años, pero su jefe fue absuelto por falta de pruebas.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El veintiuno (21) de abril de dos mil once (2011) en Caicedonia (Valle) ocurre el atroz asesinato de Jenifer Hoyos una niña de nueve (9) años a manos de Yeison Leandro Ortiz un amigo de la familia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Chinchiná, Caldas, en 2012, Angie, de 14 años, desapareció tras aceptar en secreto una cita con un hombre que le prometió un celular. Ocho días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en la vereda "La Pola". La verdad salió a la luz cuando Javier, un preso en Popayán, acusó a su propio hermano del asesinato de la menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Soacha, Doris Góngora y su hija de 8 años fueron halladas asesinadas en su vivienda. Evidencia de sangre, huellas y registros telefónicos llevaron a los investigadores hasta Jorge Antonio Trujillo, sobrino de Doris. A pesar de negar los cargos, las pruebas forenses lo vincularon directamente con el doble crimen. Fue condenado a 60 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y hurto calificado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En una vereda de Cimitarra, Santander, Pedro Suta se obsesiona con Irene, esposa de su jefe Arcilio. Tras ser rechazado, la asesina junto a su hijo menor, decapitándola y desmembrando al niño. Ese día, Arcilio estaba de viaje con otro hijo por un tratamiento médico. Al descubrirse las desapariciones, la comunidad se alerta e inicia una intensa búsqueda para dar con el responsable del doble homicidio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2015, en Caquetá, cuatro niños fueron brutalmente asesinados en su casa. Pablo, el único sobreviviente, ayudó a resolver el caso años después. La investigación reveló que Luz Mila, en disputa por tierras con la familia Vanegas, contrató a Christopher Chávez, alias "El Desalmado", y su cómplice "Chencho" para cometer el crimen. Luz Mila fue condenada a cadena perpetua, Chávez a 40 años, y "Chencho" a 20 años.

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Carlos Andrés Montoya, suboficial del ejército, perdió la vista en 2010 tras un ataque de las FARC mientras buscaba cercar al 'Mono Jojoy' en la Sierra de la Macarena. Diez años después, sigue activo en el ejército y se convirtió en psicólogo. Junto a Los Informantes, revive el lugar donde todo ocurrió, semanas antes de que Jojoy fuera abatido en la Operación Sodoma.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: En los cementerios de Bogotá opera un cartel que soborna vigilantes, policías y sepultureros para robar cadáveres y revender bóvedas varias veces. Carlos, un profanador de tumbas, revela cómo extrae y vende huesos y dientes a universidades y clínicas, ganando millones por noche. Notarías falsifican escrituras, dejando a familias como la de Jaime Molina víctimas de un fraude macabro y sistemático.

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: 6 bebés examinados...¿Cuál hombre es el padre?
programme.desc: Raymisha y Tianca tienen hijos con un hombre llamado Robert. ¡Pero Robert niega ser el padre! ¡Estas mujeres quieren que asuma el rol! Más tarde, Ashley cometió un error y ahora teme que su familia quede destrozada para siempre.

programme.title: Maury
programme.sub-title: ¡El ADN demostrará que mi papá no es el padre de tu bebé!
programme.desc: La familia de Deshan duda de que Joshua Jr. sea suyo y exigen prueba de paternidad. Melissa, 24, tuvo un bebé con Rob, 47, pero la hija de él pide ADN. ¡Todo se revela hoy en MAURY!

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: Mi hijo dijo que lo golpeaste
programme.desc: Davonna defiende a Michael de acusaciones de abuso a su hijo. El niño afirma que Michael lo golpeó, pero Evie insiste en que nunca lo maltrató y busca demostrar que merece la custodia frente a la madre.

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.desc: Pamela quiere pesar 40 libras. Samantha, que sufre de bulimia y alcoholismo, roba para consumir sus atracones. ¿Pueden las dos mujeres lidiar con sus desórdenes alimenticios con apoyo y tratamiento?

programme.title: Steve Wilkos
programme.sub-title: Ella vendió a su bebé por $23
programme.desc: Kandie era la tutora del hijo de Katie, quien falleció con tan solo 9 meses. Katie cree que Kandie tuvo algo que ver con su muerte, pero Kandie afirma que lo quería más que Katie e incluso la acusa de vendérselo por 23 dólares.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Harta del maltrato en su relación, Carla le dice a su novio que es infiel con su compañero de cuarto. Luego, Jay quiere decirle a Nikki que ella se acostó con su amante Crystal.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Hope ha venido a enfrentarse a su mejor amiga, Laura, por robarle a su novio, Joey, y luego comprometerse con él. A continuación, John dirá que no tiene la culpa por acostarse con la mejor amiga de su novia.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Destiny confronta a su amiga por invadir la propiedad de otras personas; una confesión de proporciones épicas podría ser un factor decisivo; un secreto oculto puede alterar los planes de una pareja.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: El marido de Darleen dice que es adicto a los clubes de striptease; el novio de Mary está obsesionado con limpiar su coche, y ella sospecha que lo está usando como tapadera para algo más; el miedo de Jesse al compromiso lo mete en problemas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.sub-title: ¡No te vas a casar con él!
programme.desc: ¡Amigos y familiares se niegan a aceptar el matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo! Martin no quiere que su hijo se case con su novio. April quiere recuperar a su ex, ¡pero está enamorado de un hombre! ¿Quién tiene la última palabra?

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.sub-title: El Crimen De Maria Mercedes Gnecco Parte Ii
programme.desc: El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco se ha convertido en un caso de gran controversia. La Fiscalía acusa a su esposo, de montar una escena para ocultar su culpabilidad. La investigación revela posibles motivos económicos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Cuando dos granjeros conocidos desaparecen, la policía rastrea un teléfono para encontrar al sospechoso.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Daniela Castaño, de 19 años, fue brutalmente asesinada en La Estrella, Antioquia, en enero de 2020. Su asesina, Valentina García, recibió solo 10 años de cárcel tras un polémico preacuerdo con la Fiscalía, lo que indignó a su familia y expertos legales.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Edgar Vallejo, desaparecido en diciembre de 2022, dejó una carta de advertencia a su hija, revelando que saldría con su hermano José Miguel. Tras investigaciones, se descubrió su trágico paradero, el motivo, sus bienes inmuebles y su dinero.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Cajicá, Marta Ávila dejó de pagar arriendo y se negó a desalojar la casa de Stefan y Ana Gonzenbach. En Montería, la finca de Adriana Gómez fue invadida por familias tras ser desalojada por paramilitares. En Armenia, Weimar González invadió los lotes de Edgar Vélez y Juan Diego Zapata.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.sub-title: Delitos a causa de la falta de regulación de líneas telefónicas y SIM Card en Colombia
programme.desc: En Colombia, la compra de SIM Cards prepago sin cédula facilita delitos como extorsión y robo de celulares. Miller Steven Falla fue asesinado por su celular, mostrando la gravedad del problema. Expertos y autoridades piden registro obligatorio para reducir estos crímenes.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En las sombras de las cárceles colombianas, las visitas conyugales se convierten en escenarios de horror. Reclusos peligrosos, aprovechando fallas en la seguridad, transforman momentos íntimos en tragedias.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Luz Stella García fue asesinada por su esposo Luis Antonio Quilcue tras años de celos y violencia. Él alegó defensa propia y recibió una condena reducida de 5 años y 4 meses, pese a evidencia de premeditación.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2008, Marco Iván Parrado, un menor de edad, desapareció en Arbeláez, Cundinamarca. Aunque se sospechó de un rapto por las FARC, un celular reveló su cuerpo abandonado en la selva. Las evidencias llevaron a Juan Carlos Mayorga, vigilante del pueblo con antecedentes de pedofilia, como el principal sospechoso del crimen.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Willie, Paint it Black? - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With SEMA 2018 looming on the horizon, it’s time to address the elephant in the room. When the engine for the A100 shows up it’s time to unbox one of the most powerful engines Graveyard Carz has ever put in a car!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get down to work like never before in order to get the A100 ready for SEMA which is only weeks away. With time flying and stress mounting the team works long hours and weekends trying to finish this iconic build. With SEMA only days away, the A100 finally gets it’s iconic 426 HEMI engine, well, if they can make it fit!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.sub-title: Night of the Little Dead Wagon - Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: There is no time left, SEMA is almost here but the iconic A100 still needs some buttoning up. With the A100 finished the team heads out to SEMA in order to roll the Little Dead Wagon over the red carpet for Mopar and Mark once again receives a very kind gift from our friends.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: Graveyard Carz

programme.title: K1
programme.sub-title: K1 World Grand Prix: Finals, Tokyo, 2003
programme.desc: K-1 World Grand Prix 2003 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. The event was held at the Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan on Saturday, December 6, 2003 in front of 67,320 spectators. It was the eleventh K-1 World Grand Prix final involving ten of the world's best fighters (two being reservists). The eight finalists had almost all qualified via preliminary events, while two additional fighters were invited as reserve fighters (for more detail on this see bulleted list below), with all bouts being fought under K-1 Rules (100 kg/156-220 lbs).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 98 features the highly anticipated return of Jamal Ben Saddik (36-9, 29 KO) against the Estonian powerhouse Uku Jürjendal (20-9, 16 KO). In the co-main event of the evening, GLORY Welterweight World Champion Chico Kwasi (43-5-1, 23 KO) is set to defend his title against number two ranked welterweight Teodor Hristov (18-3, 7 KO). Meanwhile, two of 2024’s best prospects will clash as Cem Caceres (18-1, 14 KO) faces Mory Kromah (31-2-1, 18 KO).

programme.sub-title: Asociación A.M.A; Manager lucra de videos porno
programme.desc: Claudia exige tratamiento psicológico para su marido, es adicto a darse placer a sí mismo en público y no tiene sexo con ella. Jin, cantante de hip-hop, demanda a su ex por vender videos sexuales de ambos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Danza Butoh; Romeo y Julieta callejeros
programme.desc: Alicia pide terapia para su esposa Andrea, ella practica una extraña y peligrosa danza japonesa. Carlos quiere desalojar a Lázaro, él lo mandó a prisión y se quedó con su casa y con su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amor al mentol; Todo es gracias a Dios
programme.desc: Paula es adicta a la crema de mentol y la usa en todo su cuerpo, pero la crema le causó daño a su esposo y ahora él la demanda. Fabiola se convirtió al cristianismo y por eso le pide el divorcio a su pareja.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Va contagiando VIH; Babalawo recibe machetazos de esposa
programme.desc: Por haberle transmitido sida, Sara le pide 500 mil dólares a Geovanny y la lista de las personas con las que ha tenido sexo. Claudia lo ataca con un machete, él la demanda por 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Viviana descubrió que su padre está muerto y no la abandonó como su madre dijo. También se dio cuenta de que esta ya se gastó toda la herencia que dejó el difunto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Traumado por ver a mujer parir; Marihuana o deshabilitado
programme.desc: Diana dice que su esposo cambió cuando la vio parir, ella cree que él es gay. Ahora pide la custodia de su hija y 25 mil dólares. Cynthia despide a César por fumar marihuana, él pide ser indemnizado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El hijo del sicario; Muerte segura
programme.desc: Sebastián desea emanciparse de su mamá Andrea, quien vive con un sicario involucrado en el crimen de su padre. Carlos planea ir a Puerto Rico a vengar la muerte de su amigo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ver en el baño inspira; Papá por Facebook
programme.desc: Paulina averiguó que su esposo toma fotos de los hombres en los baños públicos, por lo que desea separarse. Danilo supo por Facebook que tiene un hijo y trata de detener el proceso para darlo en adopción.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mellizas con diferentes padres; Látex contra el cigarrillo
programme.desc: Alonso pretende la custodia de una de las hijas mellizas de Antonio y Mariana. Sofía requiere que Michelle desaloje su casa porque se ha hecho adicta a olfatear los condones con semen.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mi bebé murió, quiero el tuyo; Mi sobrina Génesis
programme.desc: Renata estaba embarazada de gemelos con un donante de esperma, pero uno de los bebés nació muerto y ahora se pelean por el otro. Rolando teme que su sobrina mate a su madre, por eso pide que se vaya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Heterosexual por un año; Anguila, el electricista
programme.desc: Maritza se entera de que su novia tuvo sexo con 364 hombres, por eso la demanda y cancela la boda. La mujer de Luis quiere el divorcio porque por culpa de él casi se electrocuta su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos pide una orden de alejamiento contra su esposa, quien mantiene una papa en la vagina. Juan solicita la custodia de su hijo porque su pareja es satanista y teme por su salud física y mental.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Madre e hija disputan hijo; Misma casa 4 inquilinos desalojados
programme.desc: Karla quedó embarazada de su padrastro, al parir le dejó el bebé a su madre y ahora ella no se lo quiere devolver. Pilar le exige a Tania desalojar la casa que le alquiló antes de que la destruya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niña insatisfecha con su vagina; Anchón ayudando a otros niños
programme.desc: Una niña de 14 años tiene la vagina deformada; insatisfecha, quiere autorización para operársela y lucir mejor. Una madre no deja que su hijo autista ayude a niños con cáncer; Ignacio la amenaza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Perdí papeles por sexo; Atleta golpea esposa
programme.desc: Johnny fue despedido por no complacer el acoso sexual de su jefa; ahora exige una compensación. Ignacio golpeó a su esposa, lo grabaron y publicaron el video; él demanda a quien lo hizo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La hija de la mula; Testamento infame
programme.desc: Helen se niega a darle la residencia en EE. UU. a su hija; el papá de la niña, Felipe, la demanda para obligarla. América pide emanciparse porque descubrió que su madrastra es la amante de su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Donación post mortem para arte; La lucha por Sabrina
programme.desc: Una artista dona su cadáver para exponerlo en una galería de arte, pero su marido Luciano intenta impedirlo. Luis quiere quitarle la custodia de su hermana con síndrome de Down a su enfermera Libia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marian exige que Gary interne a su hermana, pero él alega que Emily solo necesita unión familiar. A Karla le traumatizaba el tráfico, quiso cambiar de horario y fue despedida; ahora exige una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Dúo de magia; Hija con cáncer y embarazada
programme.desc: Un mago quiere desalojar a su aprendiz por revelar muchos trucos. Una adolescente está embarazada, pero tiene cáncer. Sus padres debaten si salvar la vida del futuro bebé o la de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina enviudó y se casó con Franco. Pero el esposo de Paulina reapareció y ahora Franco los demanda. Federico es minusválido y sufre de erecciones. Elizabeth se aprovechó y se embarazó, pero ahora Federico reclama al bebé.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo de mi hermano no; Luchadora para salvar hijo
programme.desc: Raquel necesita ser parte de la vida de su hijo con Roberto, pero este dice que no porque el niño es producto de un incesto. Tania es una ex luchadora que quiere volver al ring, pero su hijo se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Papaya y pepino; Golpe por golpe
programme.desc: Un hombre le da educación sexual a dos niñas con vegetales; una madre lo denuncia. La esposa de una de las víctimas de un juego mortal demanda al agresor de su marido por 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amenazas por Facebook; Esposa millonaria vieja
programme.desc: David subió un video en Facebook donde dice que va a matar a su amiga; piden una orden de alejamiento. Camilo quiere sacar a su mujer de la casa y quedarse con la sirvienta que se ganó la lotería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Depredador injusto; Padre stripper, scary boyfriend
programme.desc: María le exige a su marido que desaloje a su hermano por ser un depredador sexual, ella teme por su niña. Un padre acusa a la madre de su hijo de ser drogadicta y pide la patria potestad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cocaína para pre eyaculación; Legalización venta de órganos
programme.desc: Camilo usa cocaína como remedio para su eyaculación precoz; la esposa denuncia que la drogó. Un padre quiere comprar un riñón en Irán para su hija, pero la madre demanda que se lo prohíban.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo preso por defender a novia; Lesbianas odian a los hombres
programme.desc: El hijo de Melba está preso en Colombia por defender a su novia; la mamá pide que ella lo ayude. Mario quiere quitarle su hija a Elly, alega que ella la contamina con odio hacia los hombres.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Youtube reina del toilet; Se inyecta pene
programme.desc: Un hombre planea convertir a su esposa en "la reina del toilet". Elizabeth, su suegra, pide una orden de alejamiento. Iván se inyecta un medicamento en el pene para más potencia; su esposa quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La chismosa de la farándula; Esposo cojo, esposa asexual
programme.desc: La Pitonisa exige una orden de alejamiento por agresión contra la cantante Nati. Pedro quiere divorciarse de Ana, quien alega ser asexual. Pedro asegura que ella lo rechaza porque le falta una pierna.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El barbero del bichote; Riñón por virginidad
programme.desc: Nathaniel le exige a Medi que le devuelva la custodia de su sobrino. Carla le dona un riñón al hombre que ama a cambio de que le quite su virginidad. Ahora la esposa demanda a la donante.

programme.title: Toda Mujer

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luis francisco va a la empresa Talamonti para hablar y se encuentra que la presidenta es Clemencia y esta lo odia, al mismo tiempo aparece Augusto que no entiende lo que sucede. Clemencia se queda a solas con Luis Francisco y lo trata con indiferencia. Luis Francisco le confiesa que Augusto es su hermano y Clemencia supone acertadamente que éste está en busca de dinero. programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal tiene cada vez más sospechas sobre Ana y Guillermo, y los invita a un almuerzo para tratar de que ellos durante una charla confiesen involuntariamente que se conocían de antes. Ellos tratan de conversar como si nada pasara, pero es imposible ambos estan enamorados y tratan de evitar que Cristóbal se dé cuenta. La idea del almuerzo fue de Pedro que como espía a todos en el edificio, sabe lo que le pasa a cada persona que vive allí. Venancio sigue sospechando de Pedro y su relación con el hombre muerto que apareció junto al río, pero el estafador aprovechará el interrogatorio para dar vuelta el tablero y sembrar celos de Venancio hacia Lázara, la ex mujer del policía.

programme.title: Episodio 110 (2026)
programme.desc: Junior y los demás están recibiendo a los invitados. Llega Pastor con Ana. Todos se sorprenden pro Olegario está que ni habla. Dionisia y ROKUro se citan en una heladería. Dionisia piensa que es para decirle la verdad | que no es médico. Pero el lo que hace es darle una tarjeta con su teléfono. Dionisia está feliz y no le importa que no le diga nada. programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Milagros y Enzo están en el ascensor y mientras ella cuenta para que él lo haga andar él le quita los documentos de la cartera para que ella tenga que volver a verlo. Vicky está enojada porque vio a Enzo besándose con Milagros. Él trata de compensarla llevándola al club, pero cuando ella se va a la habitación él se escapa para la empresa para volver a ver a Milagros, quien va a buscar sus documentos. Augusto revisa a María Gracia y no encuentra ninguna herida, por lo que le dice que está bien.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Cristóbal confirma sus sospechas con respecto a Ana y a su primo, sabe que ambos le están mintiendo pero no va a decir nada porque no quiere perder a su novia antes de casarse. Escucha los consejos de Pedro de que mantenga la calma y no la cele porque lo único que va a lograr es que Ana lo deje. Ana siente que cuando más conoce a Guillermo más se da cuenta que es el hombre de su vida. Mientras tanto Nancy explota cuando llegan a su apartamento Lázara y Pedro con la intención de hablar con Carlos de las cuentas del condominio, todo armado por el Fantasma que crea cizaña con todos. Nancy se va del apartamento enojada a buscar a un vecino que si admira su belleza y la piropea.

programme.title: Episodio 111 (2026)
programme.desc: Wilker y Yubiri se besan como les exigen en la película pero ellos se besan de verdad y cuando dicen corten | ellos siguen besándose. Intervienen entonces Briggite y Juan Diego. Lolita trata de convencer a Solymar que lo que es del cura va para la iglesia. Freddy se burla de Yubiri por lo del beso. Briggite llega y también le dice que terminó siendo una gran actriz Carolina y Juan Diego tienen una gran discusión. Ella le reclama que haya dicho corte por el megáfono.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Sofía continúa haciendo todo lo posible por lograr que Agustín y Magdalena se divorcien, ya que lo quiere solamente para ella. Esta vez, lo emborracha y lo convence de pasar la noche juntos. Agustín no vuelve a su casa hasta el otro día, cuando pone la excusa de que ha tenido que dormir solo en un hotel. Gabriel empieza a darse cuenta de la gravedad de su enfermedad y se emociona hablando con Gloria de los viejos tiempos en que los dos junto con Epicúreo eran inseparables. Está dispuesto a hacer todo con tal de no morirse a causa de su problema en los riñones. Maikel está cansado de la mentira de su tío a Valentina, está cansado de que lo vean como una persona que no es. Es por eso que, aparentemente, puede llegar a decir toda la verdad que Epicúreo tiene tan bien guardada.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, pide ser enterrada con su vestido de novia y Ricardo promete casarse con ella al día siguiente. Mientras tanto, Manuela intenta mediar en el conflicto entre Ricardo, Misael y Glorita. René y Gustavo son arrestados tras un altercado, y Katiuska muestra su desprecio hacia la servidumbre. A pesar de su fiebre alta, Celia se niega a ir al médico y prefiere pasear con su familia para que todos los vean unidos antes de partir.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos logra que Junior reaccione tras el desmayo. Adolfo y Consuelo revelan a Rosa que su matrimonio debe anularse porque Junior es su hermano; ella confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro. Rosa jura que siempre considerará a Carmen Rosa como su única madre y nunca dejará a Junior solo.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders (2023)
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies (2023)
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us (2023)
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story (2023)
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax (2023)
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Brent starts his day with some adrenaline pumping sea karting on the West Coast of the Island. He then heads to the home of Manuella to have an Otentik Creole experience with her and her family. A mix of African and European cuisines influenced by Asia, Creole cuisine is a delicious, colorful melting pot of flavours and Manuella teaches Brent just how to blend these notes to create a unique dish. Tasty creole food and too much rum later Brent is having a ball. The next morning Brent hits the markets to get his ingredients for his creole inspired dish. Heading back to the Ravenala hotel he has a refresher before cooking up his own creole creation on the Riviera Riverside.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: The boys roll into Delaware and are on a historical quest for gunpowder! Cannons, battle axes, historic houses and a cozy tavern will also be explored on their journey.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Sarah Graham visits the Travers family at the Imire Wildlife Conservancy in Zimbabwe. There she makes a delicious meal of mushroom risotto, green salad with toasted almonds and mini milk tarts.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Host Chef Phillip Davenport asks why so very few people outside of Malaysia ever discuss, let alone praise its fine dining venues so we begin by providing the evidence that the Capital city Kuala Lumpur has the fine dining credentials and an ever growing list of culinary geniuses.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil delves into the KL city's suburban and modern mall food culture. His theory is that a measure of a cities culinary excellence is how good the suburban restaurants are.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Amid the leafy enclosure of KL suburbia lies a piece of exotic Ceylon, namely Aliyaa Restaurant and Bar and its where Chef Phil discovers exec Chef Pradeep specialising in his signature dry cooked curries.This is what fine dining Sri Lankan cuisine is all about.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Isadora Chai is a chef who was a scientist so experimentation is what she thrives on and when she opens her mouth this chef can swear like Gordon Ramsay and invariably does. A fun episode

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: A beautiful tropical island, two world class restaurants and two great Chefs ,Chef Phil and his old friend Chef Richard. They take us on a culinary tour de force presenting some intriguing western recipes and a range delicious modern Langkawi/Malaysia fare.This is a recipe intense episode with plenty to see and learn.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Chef Phil arrives at the Imperial Sheraton, home of the Celestial Court and his base while he uncovers the enormous culinary exercise that takes place every day here. We begin the Celestial Court where the decisions on what to cook are tough but we end up with classic crispy skinned Roast Duck, Di Sum and a Wok fried Chilli Tempe thats a world beater.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This place rocks and it does in a very Argentinian way.The best meat cooked to perfection is what we see and learn how to achieve. At Pampas meat is what they are all about and Chef Phil discovers thats why the place is packed out every night.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This is an episode dedicated to decadence. Sit back, relax and salivate. Chef Phil and Chef Gaeton take us through the intracacies of making a modern boulliabase from scratch. It is an art. As well we will learn what herbs and spices it takes to lift any gin to levels heavenly.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: We are nearly 60 stories up looking over super KL modern city with the twin towers in our face. This is Italian high end cuisine cooked by owner/chef Modesto Marini himself. We see him with Chef Phil in the working kitchen cooking some Marini signatures and later at the bar delving into some mysterious cocktails.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: This Venue is quite simply downright impressive and the big question to come was will the kitchen produce a match for where it will be presented. We see Chef Phil work his way through the decadent degustation then migrate to the kitchen to learn about the preparation.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Another extraordinarily extravagant venue in the centre of the KL Culinary universe. Marble 8 is like a club for the rich and famous in New York or Hollywood and from from what Chef eats, drinks and cooks it could as well be.This is a lavish treat from the walk through the steak aging vault to the flaming crepe suzette prepared at the table.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: Yet another culinary gem in the suburbs of KL.This is real Italian with an intense Abruzzian Italian at the helm. Chef Stefano is young and like most great Italian chefs Stefano’s inspiration came from his mothers cooking.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Indian Monsoon"
programme.desc: In June of next year we plan to intercept the Monsoon as it hits southern India and makes its way north along the western shore past Goa and Mumbai up to Delhi.This most famous of torrential rainy seasons drops as much as 40 feet of water.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Java - Land of Fire"
programme.desc: The most notorious volcanic explosion in history came from the small island of Krakatoa, off the coast of Java. The tiny island was pulverized and the giant explosion was felt half way around the world. Java is at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Tank"
programme.desc: Hand powered tank, is that possible? Leonardo Da Vinci thought so. Today we will test this theory.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.sub-title: Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck"
programme.sub-title: RAF Station, Typhoon Squadron, The Flight Deck
programme.desc: We're at Royal Air Force station Brize Norton, Oxfordshire, where we've been given an exclusive look at the RAF's ground-breaking, multi-role refuelling and transporter aircraft, the Voyager.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Targeting & Tracking, Navigation, Seagoing Drones"
programme.desc: We reveal an experimental sensor, monitoring and targeting system developed for troops by the UK's Defence Science and Technology Laboratory and Roke Manor Research. The iXblue Marins navigation black box guides navy ships.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping"
programme.sub-title: NATO Maritime Centre, No Shipping-No Shopping
programme.desc: We visit NATO's Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation in La Spezia, Italy. We learn how the world's oceans are one of the last places that military technology can be hidden from prying eyes.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics"
programme.sub-title: Terrorist Threats, Sea Wasp Robot, Combat Medics
programme.desc: With an increasing terrorist threat to ports and shipping, the Swedish manufacturer SAAB has developed the Sea Wasp, an under-water robot for detecting explosive devices.

programme.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Fuel for Destruction"
programme.desc: The atomic age introduces powerful rockets and nuclear energy, balancing technological advancement with threats like the Chernobyl disaster.

programme.title: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Golden Age of Science"
programme.desc: Military funding drives a boom in earth sciences and biological research, creating advanced weapons alongside deeper insights into our world.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "US Aviation"
programme.desc: Henry Ford's plan to build a giant factory in Michigan, covering 3.5million sq ft and including an aircraft production line half a mile in length.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Occupied Territories"
programme.desc: The sabotaging efforts of Peugeot in Nazi-occupied France, where the bosses and workers cooperated with the Resistance to hinder the Nazis' use of military vehicles.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "US Ships"
programme.desc: The story of America's `Liberty Ships', which were produced in incredible numbers and became known as the Model T Fords of the ocean.

programme.title: War Factories S1 - "Episode 08"
programme.desc: The remarkable story of how Stalin's massive war factories were dismantled and moved east on one and half million railway trucks, to avoid being lost to the Nazis.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Artillery"
programme.desc: Artillery, the King of Battle, is explored as gunners train with powerful weapons and prepare for modern combat deployment.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "First Ten Combat Missions"

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Army Combatives"
programme.desc: At Fort Benning’s Army Combatives School, soldiers train in brutal hand-to-hand combat, learning real-world skills to fight and survive.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Stealth Submarines"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Shelter"
programme.desc: In Colombia and Singapore, earthrise looks at sustainable forms of shelter.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Land Gaining Ground"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Survival"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Antarctica On The Edge"

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Coping With Extremes"

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Oceans"
programme.desc: Throughout history, human society has run on trade. The innovations that allowed faster and more accurate oceanic travel revolutionized the world. New inventions now help people and goods move on the water faster for recreation and commerce.

programme.title: Speed S1 - "Across Continents"

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Second Annual Student Astronaut Contest"

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "Space Bots"

programme.title: The Maya (2025)
programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.

programme.title: The Aztecs (2025)
programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.

programme.title: The Incas (2025)
programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.

programme.title: First Before Columbus (2025)
programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun (2025)
programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.

programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World (2025)
programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.

programme.title: The East (2025)
programme.desc: After the war, hunger and adversity shape daily life in East Germany. Many Berliners go to the countryside in search of food. In the city, a notorious gang of youths is up to no good.

programme.title: The West (2025)
programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.

programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany (2025)
programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: The D-Days Spies (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how agents tricked the Germans to keep their troops out of Normandy.

programme.title: The Soldier who never was (2025)
programme.desc: Discover a darkly humorous British ploy that helped the 1943 landing in Sicily.

programme.title: The Spy who Saved the World (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.

programme.title: The A-Bomb Spies (2025)
programme.desc: Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.

programme.title: The Rise of Judea (2025)
programme.desc: The Rise of Judea explores the tumultuous reign of King Herod and the ascent of Roman stewardship in Judea through the words of Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: The Fall of Judea (2025)
programme.desc: The Fatal Conflict Episode 2 explores the events that shaped the great Jewish revolt against Rome, as recorded by Jewish General, historian and perceived traitor, Flavius Josephus.

programme.title: Birth of a Brotherhood (2025)
programme.desc: At the beginning of the 12th century, a few knights decide to create a new brotherhood called "The order of the Temple".

programme.title: A business empire (2025)
programme.desc: In the middle of the 12th century, the order of the Temple becomes increasingly popular among the kings and peoples of Western Europe.

programme.title: The fall of the order (2025)
programme.desc: At the end of the 13th century, as Christian holdings in the holy land have disappeared, the Templars continue to push for a new crusade.

programme.title: In the Footsteps of Jesus (2025)
programme.desc: For the past 2000 years, he has remained the most famous character of History. Described as a leader, as a feminist, an anarchist, a healer. But today, what do we really know about Jesus?

programme.title: The Miracles of Jesus (2025)
programme.desc: For more than 2000 years, he has been the most discussed character in History. What do we really know about Jesus today?

programme.title: The Quest for the Ark of the Covenant (2025)
programme.desc: In Judaism, it’s the most sacred object. A chest carved in acacia wood, gilded with gold leaf, and topped by two cherubs. The Ark of the Covenant strikes down the Mortal who touches it.

programme.title: The Quest for the Grail (2025)
programme.desc: It’s the most desired and sacred relic in Christianity. However, this artefact is shrouded in mystery. No one can say what it looks like. Today, dozens of churches claim to hold the Grail.

programme.title: The Power of King Solomon (2025)
programme.desc: Solomon is a mythical figure of the Old Testament. Third king of Israel, he reigned from 970 to 931 BC. But did he really exist?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is My Teen Blinded By Love?
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: A Teen Girl Obsessed With Her Ex
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

Rheta says she's so fed up with their mother-and-son bond that she's filed for divorce, shredded her wedding vows and has even come to blows with Deb on several occasions. Mark agrees that his mother is too involved, but can he break ties while Deb holds the purse strings? Does paying the couple's rent and providing them with a car give Deb license to criticize Rheta and try to set Mark up with other women? Rheta says that on some days, she and Mark are best friends, but their arguments get so heated that they've turned physical -- in front of their three children. Will a grand gesture from Mark keep Rheta from walking away? Can Rheta and Deb mend fences?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some believe self-censorship is a big problem today, particularly in light of the idea that someone can be "canceled" for their words -- blocked from having a prominent public platform or career for sharing their opinion. Dr. Phil interviews Nate, a former Idaho police officer, who claims he was fired after making a TikTok video about NBA superstar LeBron James that went viral and has been viewed over 4 million times. Nate explains how the fall-out from the video affected him and his family, too. Dr. Phil also speaks with conservative political commentator Tomi Lahren, who says she recently had to be protected by state police from student protestors at the University of New Mexico. Greg Lukianoff, president of the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, says he believes Americans have lost the ability to discuss their differences rationally. And, Dr. Shaun Harper, founder and Executive Director of the USC Race and Equity Center, says he is firmly against hate speech and feels people need to be more mindful about the effects of their words.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: You Said It, Now You’re Canceled! Pt 2
programme.desc: The “self-censorship” debate continues. Meet Alejandro, a student who claims administrators at his community college violated his free speech rights. He says when he and members of the club Young Americans for Freedom posted flyers on campus, they were censored. Then, which public figures are fighting back against cancel culture? And, Dr. Phil takes a closer look at a list of terms that are now allegedly off limits. What words are on that list? Tune in to find out.

programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on.
